name: lever seated one leg squat
description: A seated machine squat done on one leg. It lets you load each leg separately with good support.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place one foot on the platform at about shoulder width.
Lower under control by bending your knee.
Keep your heel flat and your knee in line with your toes.
Press back up, then switch legs after your reps.
